headline: WNBA Semifinals Game 2: Liberty fight to level series against surging Dream
whyCareReason: Atlanta lead 1-0 after Game 1 upset; defending finalist Liberty fight to avoid an insurmountable 0-2 deficit.
teaser: Wednesday 7 October, Gateway Center Arena. Atlanta look for 2-0 command.
story: The Atlanta Dream host the New York Liberty in Game 2 of their best-of-five WNBA Semifinal on Wednesday night at Gateway Center Arena. Atlanta snatched home-court advantage in Game 1 with a 92-82 win, driven by Jordin Canada's 25 points (20 in the second half) and 5 steals, alongside DeWanna Bonner's 23 points. New York, despite 27 points from Sabrina Ionescu and 19 from Breanna Stewart, was outscored 32-15 in a decisive third quarter. Out west, the Golden State Valkyries also carry a 1-0 lead over the Las Vegas Aces heading into Wednesday's Game 2 in San Francisco.
stakes: Series momentum. Atlanta seek 2-0 command; New York battle for home-court split.
rivalryAngle: Underdog fourth-seed Dream seek to push last year's finalists to the brink.
